name: font-scout
description: Change text in Figma with the fonts on your computer, through the Font Scout plugin.
long_description: Claude's own Figma tools run on Figma's servers, which only have Google Fonts and the fonts an organization shares, so text in any other font can't be changed there. With the Font Scout plugin open in a Figma file, these tools do the work in Figma on your computer, where every font installed on it is available.

tools.name: figma_status
tools.description: The Figma files the Font Scout plugin is open in, and windows waiting to be paired

tools.name: figma_pair
tools.description: Pairs a plugin window with the 6-digit code it shows

tools.name: figma_find_fonts
tools.description: Font families Figma can use on this computer, with their exact style names

tools.name: figma_get_texts
tools.description: Text layers with their text, fonts and missing fonts

tools.name: figma_set_text
tools.description: Replaces a text layer's text, keeping its styling

tools.name: figma_set_font
tools.description: Sets the font of text layers, or of some of their characters

tools.name: figma_run
tools.description: Runs Figma Plugin API JavaScript in the open file

tools.name: figma_screenshot
tools.description: A picture of a layer, drawn with its real fonts
